_comment: Historical case store. Single shared case_id space for BOTH retrieve_similar_cases (Track 3) and flag_at_risk_batch matched_case_ids (Track 2) - see PLAN_REVIEW P1-7. Constructed from the WM-811K defect taxonomy and documented fab failure modes; NOT disclosed fab incidents.

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Slurry flow rate drift from a degrading slurry pump on CMP-03
cases.outcome: Pump seal replaced; yield recovered to 94% within 2 lots

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Polishing pad used past qualified life; calendar PM had not yet triggered
cases.outcome: Pad replaced; PM policy moved to condition-based

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Incoming slurry vendor lot with out-of-spec viscosity
cases.outcome: Vendor lot quarantined; incoming QC gate added

cases.confirmed_root_cause: RF power edge effect following chamber PM reassembly
Partially clogged edge gas nozzle causing flow distribution imbalance
Chamber wall seasoning drift after another product line changed the recipe on a shared tool
cases.outcome: Seasoning requalified; shared-tool recipe change notification added

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Wafer-handling robot end-effector wear - no process sensor correlation
Cassette slot 13 misalignment - positional, not sensor-detectable
Stepper lens thermal drift tracking ambient fab temperature
cases.outcome: HVAC setpoint stabilised; lens comp model retrained

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Reticle contamination introduced during a reticle swap
Focus map miscalibration introduced by a stepper firmware update
cases.outcome: Firmware rolled back; focus map recalibrated

cases.confirmed_root_cause: HEPA filter degradation - cleanroom particle counter led the wafer defect trend by 3 days
Chamber seal wear generating particles only during long runs
Contamination introduced during an unscheduled emergency maintenance entry
Power supply fault cascading through the CMP process step
Equipment interlock software bug misrouted otherwise-good wafers
cases.outcome: Interlock firmware patched; lots reworked, not scrapped

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Parametric test head miscalibration produced false failure readings - wafers were within spec
cases.outcome: Test head recalibrated; lots retested and released

cases.confirmed_root_cause: Probe card contact resistance drift causing systematic false fails
